subsystems.name: Superconducting coil set
subsystems.role: creates the external magnetic field that bends incoming charged particles away from the crew volume.

subsystems.name: Cryogenic and thermal control
subsystems.role: keeps the coils at superconducting temperature and rejects their heat in vacuum.

subsystems.name: Power system
subsystems.role: supplies continuous high current for the coils plus the cooling load.

subsystems.name: Plasma source
subsystems.role: for plasma-inflated variants, injects plasma that expands the magnetic bubble far beyond the physical coils.

subsystems.name: Field shaping and control
subsystems.role: tunes the field topology so the weak cusp regions never sit over the crew volume, and keeps the field stable under changing solar wind.

subsystems.name: Shielded habitat core
subsystems.role: the crew volume, positioned in the region of strongest deflection.
parts: secondary passive shielding for neutrons and secondary particles

buildSteps.title: Characterise the threat
buildSteps.detail: Set the mission trajectory and duration, then compute the galactic cosmic ray spectrum and worst-case solar particle event fluxes and energies the shield must deflect.

buildSteps.title: Model and optimise the field
buildSteps.detail: Simulate charged-particle trajectories through proposed coil geometries, requiring the ion gyroradius to be smaller than the distance from the coil to the habitat, and iterating until coil mass, power and cooling are minimised for a target dose reduction.

buildSteps.title: Wind and test the coils
buildSteps.detail: Wind high-temperature superconducting tape into coils, then test them at operating temperature and current, including deliberate quenches to prove the coil survives.

buildSteps.title: Build the cryogenic loop
buildSteps.detail: Integrate cryocoolers, insulation and radiators sized so the coils stay cold in vacuum while carrying their full current.

buildSteps.title: Build the plasma source
buildSteps.detail: For inflatable-magnetosphere variants, build a small plasma thruster-like source and characterise the bubble it inflates in a large vacuum chamber using magnetometers and probes.

buildSteps.title: Integrate a subscale test article
buildSteps.detail: Combine coil, cryogenics, power and diagnostics into a flight-representative unit, then fire a proton or ion beam at it and measure the deflection and secondary particle field.

buildSteps.title: Fly a demonstrator
buildSteps.detail: Fly the unit uncrewed through a harsh radiation environment with detectors placed where a crew would sit, comparing measured dose behind the field against an unshielded reference.

buildSteps.title: Scale to a habitat
buildSteps.detail: Enlarge the coils to enclose a crew volume, close the mass and power budgets, and demonstrate it on an uncrewed deep-space platform before any crewed mission relies on it.

prerequisites.why: the field strength and coil mass depend entirely on current density in the superconductor.
instrument-class cryocoolers exist, but a habitat shield needs far more cooling capacity and radiator area.
continuous megawatt-class power would be needed to drive the coils and the cryogenic load.

prerequisites.tech: Validated plasma and radiation transport models
prerequisites.why: designs rest on simulation; the field-particle interaction must be verified by measurement, not theory alone.
no flight experiment has yet shown a field of this kind reducing dose behind it.

pathway.milestone: analytic design studies and vacuum-chamber experiments with small coils and plasma sources
pathway.unlocks: a defensible model of how much a given field deflects a given particle, and what it costs in mass and power.

pathway.milestone: an uncrewed free-flyer demonstrator carrying a coil and detectors through radiation belts or a solar event
pathway.unlocks: the first measured dose reduction from an active shield in space.

pathway.milestone: a subscale shield integrated with habitat life support on a long uncrewed deep-space mission
pathway.unlocks: operation of superconducting coils and cryogenics for years without servicing.

pathway.milestone: a full-scale shielded habitat qualified for a crewed Mars-class mission
pathway.unlocks: deep-space missions that do not have to carry the very large mass penalty of passive shielding alone.
